tagline: Cracked it? We fix phones and laptops while you wait.
intro: Screens, batteries and water damage repaired the same day in the Northern Quarter, with a price you see before we start.
trust: Most repairs in under an hour
about:
Pixel Fix opened in 2017 in a unit the size of a lift. We now have a bright workshop on Oldham Street and six technicians who would rather mend a phone than sell you a new one.

Every repair has a fixed price, quality parts and a 12-month warranty. If we cannot fix it, you do not pay.

services.name: Screen replacement
services.description: Cracked or unresponsive screens replaced for iPhone, Samsung, Pixel and iPad.

services.name: Battery replacement
services.description: A new battery fitted and tested in about thirty minutes.

services.name: Water damage
services.description: Opened, cleaned and dried properly, with an honest report on what we find.

services.name: Laptop repair
services.description: Keyboards, hinges, screens and slow machines for Mac and Windows.

services.name: Data recovery
services.description: Photos and files rescued from phones and drives that will not turn on.

services.name: Charging and ports
services.description: Loose or dead charging ports cleaned or replaced.

values.title: Price first
values.text: You see a fixed price before we open your device.

values.title: No fix, no fee
values.text: If we cannot repair it, the diagnosis costs you nothing.

values.title: Your data stays put

process.title: Tell us what broke
process.text: Pick your device and the problem to get a price in seconds.

process.title: Drop in or post it
process.text: Walk in any day, or use our free tracked postal service.

process.title: We repair it
process.text: Most jobs take under an hour. We text you when it is ready.

process.title: Test and collect
process.text: We test everything with you before you pay.

faq.a: Screens and batteries usually take 30 to 60 minutes. Water damage and laptops can take a day or two.
Almost never. Screen and battery repairs do not touch your data. We still recommend a backup first.
We offer genuine parts where they are available and high-quality alternatives at a lower price. You choose.
Any fault with the part or our work for 12 months. It does not cover new accidental damage.
